blocks.md: **Greedy = at every step take what looks BEST NOW. It's legal ONLY when a swap argument proves now-best can't hurt later.**
Two habits this level: (1) TRY the obvious greedy, (2) TEST it on a tiny nasty example before trusting. Wrong greedy is the most common contest bug class.
